key_insight: Spatially extended quantum measurements can emerge from strictly local operations composed through the causal dynamics of a quantum cellular automaton.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a causally constrained design approach for distributed measurements in lattice-based quantum simulators.
method: Represent local instruments using localized completely positive maps.
Compose finite, non-adaptive measurement protocols across the automaton’s causal cone.
Derive effective measurements and spatial support bounds on the initial time slice.
evidence_signal: An explicit two-step construction realizes a Bell-basis projective measurement at suitable parameters and deformed Bell measurements elsewhere, with quantified entanglement and stabilizer Rényi non-classicality.
watch_item: The abstract provides a theoretical construction, not experimental validation or an assessment of noise tolerance.
paper_title: Local Measurement Theory for Quantum Cellular Automata
